cohort: 17,936 cord blood donations collected between 1999 and 2011 from the Tuscany and Apulia Cord Blood Banks
finding: Cord blood volume, total nucleated cells, and stem cells exhibit rhythmic patterns in different time domains and frequencies, suggesting that temporal rhythms, in addition to known obstetric and neonatal parameters, influence these factors in cord blood units.
mod_finding: Cord blood volume, total nucleated cells, and stem cells are associated with mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Analysed as a factor influencing cord blood parameters
